_about: The vocabulary this pack delivers. Empty until the interview fills it: classes, relations and attributes derived from the questions the graph must answer (the ontology-interview skill); `oto pack check` holds it to its gates, `oto pack try` tries it in the trial project beside this pack.
_summary: Contracts and what each obliges us to

Contract.definition: An agreement to buy from a supplier, with a start and an end.

Obligation.definition: Something a contract obliges one side to do.

name: e2e-contracts

supplied_by.definition: The supplier a contract buys from. The supplier lives in the suppliers graph; here it is a reference to it.
